name: legitimate-brand-country-domain
description: False-positive resistance for a brand's own name under a country suffix the brand table does not list. A multinational runs one name across every market it sells in, the table lists a handful of those domains per brand, and thirty-odd brands against two hundred country suffixes is not a list anyone can finish. Reading an unlisted one such as `paypal.it` as a `critical` imitation of `paypal.com` would put a severity floor under authentic mail and make it High Risk. The uncertainty must be reported once, at a severity that sets no floor, saying what the reader can check.
